VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: Pyromancer
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Pyromancers believe fire is a force of nature that, while often used for destruction, may grant many boons when controlled. Elder Pyromancers became one with fire, allowing them to return from death after a period of time. As opposed to apprentice Pyromancers who fell due to their hubris.
